recommendations.name: Linear tracked ECS journal construction
recommendations.implementation: Fill an exactly sized or bounded temporary once, then publish the batch to the persistent journal. Separately avoid rescanning all membership words for sparse edit_selected.

recommendations.name: Linear task queue decoding and delivery
recommendations.implementation: Allocate decoded slots once; count the deliverable prefix and fill once. Audit submit_many, close and reissue for repeated whole-array copies.

recommendations.name: Page-local bulk edits
recommendations.implementation: Find each dirty page range once, copy the page once, then apply its edits directly. Retain contiguous fast paths for dense scene work and qualify that previous regression separately.

recommendations.name: Prepared scheduler execution
recommendations.implementation: Validate and normalize an immutable plan once; execute its cached waves until plan replacement. Keep complete validation at construction and untrusted boundaries.

recommendations.name: Grouped persistent map construction and edits
recommendations.evidence: Source inspection only; no measured speedup
recommendations.implementation: Group batch hashes by trie branch and rebuild shared paths once per batch. Preserve first key identity, last value, collision equality and older snapshots. Fuse alter into one descent.

recommendations.name: Reuse resting-body physics broad phase
recommendations.evidence: Source inspection only; no measured speedup
recommendations.implementation: Caller-owned endpoint/resting-body indexes, updated from movement, topology and sleep/wake changes. Preserve conservative CCD envelopes and canonical contact order. Existing physics/prepared already covers immutable fixed geometry.

languageRecommendations: Extend existing exact/staged construction analysis to private accumulating array loops and nested record fields; qualify with the queue and journal cases.
Explore packed numeric multi-constructor unions for entries such as Added U32 / Updated U32 / Removed U32. Current local numeric-layout documentation excludes multiple constructors.
limits: Exploratory local microbenchmarks, not gdev frame measurements or full-system speedups.
8 warmups and 15 alternating timed pairs; setup, execution, and complete output decoding included; result comparisons outside timing.
Journal fixture isolates tracked metadata construction plus journal write/read; it does not time full ECS component insertion. Journal retention capacity equals the batch size.

Queue timing uses ready mixed outcomes, trace disabled, and full re-encoding as a witness. Additional decoder mutations test rejection/result agreement. Lifecycle edge cases need production qualification.
Page timing performs 16 edits, either one slot per 64-slot page or every slot; initialization and full flattening included.

Scheduler timing performs 64 executions with cheap pure callbacks; dispatch and useful heavy job time are not included. Both variants validate at setup, ordinary execution additionally revalidates each time.
First five paired workloads were compiled before scheduler entries were added to the saved prototype; their kernel bodies are unchanged.
Committed memory is cumulative reusable guest capacity, not peak live allocation volume; warm replay growth was zero.
Map and physics changes are architectural candidates without prototypes.
All existing library source hashes match the preceding implementation audit.
